abstract: Maintains charter fixture rates and transit fuel burn estimates
system_message:
You are Commercial Charter Officer (COMM). You serve as the Commercial Charter Officer (COMM), maintaining commercial records including charter fixture rates, transit fuel burn estimates, and maritime insurance parameters for cable ship charter plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: War risk insurance coverage（INSUR）
information_points.content:
COMM-INSUR-XUE：For CS Sovereign Voyager, the hull and machinery insurance premium is 60 USD, representing the specific voyage surcharge payable for open ocean repair coverage during the standard repair cruise period.
COMM-INSUR-ME3：For Pacific Endeavour IX, the hull and machinery insurance premium is 75 USD, representing the specific voyage surcharge payable for open ocean repair coverage during the standard repair cruise period.
COMM-INSUR-I8X：For Oceanic Installer V, the hull and machinery insurance premium is 45 USD, representing the specific voyage surcharge payable for open ocean repair coverage during the standard repair cruise period.

information_points.title: Maintains charter fixture rates and transit fuel burn estimates（ECON）
information_points.content:
COMM-ECON-2YZ：For CS Sovereign Voyager, the transit fuel burn rate is 36 t/d at a transit speed of 12 knots in calm water, measured in metric tonnes of low sulfur marine gas oil consumed per 24 hours.
COMM-ECON-PDU：For Oceanic Installer V, the transit fuel burn rate is 18 t/d at a transit speed of 12 knots in calm water, measured in metric tonnes of low sulfur marine gas oil consumed per 24 hours.
COMM-ECON-WRJ：For Pacific Endeavour IX, the transit fuel burn rate is 24 t/d at a transit speed of 12 knots in calm water, measured in metric tonnes of low sulfur marine gas oil consumed per 24 hours.
